name: akhaliq/endless-edit-tailsteer
title: TailSteer cuts drift across long image-edit sequences
summary: TailSteer is a final training stage for image editors that keeps early denoising close to the base model and learns preservation corrections near the end of the trajectory. On FLUX, SenseNova, and Qwen editors it reduces cumulative visual drift over 15 to 20 edit turns while keeping single-turn editing performance.
